scope: Candidate gates only, no exploit tests or live evidence

rows.title: af_unix: Unlink scc_entry in unix_del_edge().
rows.source_gate: UNIX=y; own AF_UNIX socket/SCM_RIGHTS reference graph and close/send operations need no host capability or optional device. Default seccomp permits them.
rows.impact_limit: SCC garbage-collector freed-vertex traversal; shared-kernel lifetime corruption. No platform-specific host escape verified.
rows.runtime_status: not collected; source gate is not deployed proof

rows.title: fuse: re-lock request before replacing page cache folio
rows.source_gate: FUSE=m explicitly preloaded; /dev/fuse feature defaults on; downstream FUSE has FS_USERNS_MOUNT. Tenant admin can mount/operate own daemon and arrange request abort/copy lifecycle. Device permission and mount state are runtime facts.
rows.impact_limit: fuse_io_args lifetime UAF; upstream .95 already contains this correction. Inclusive range selection does not mean .95 remains vulnerable.
rows.runtime_status: not collected; source gate is not deployed proof

rows.title: bpf: Don't predict JMP32 pointer vs zero comparisons
rows.source_gate: BPF syscalls/socket filters enabled, 6.12 source unprivileged_bpf_disabled=0. check_cond_jmp_op predicts immediate-zero pointer branch before final pointer-comparison rejection. However bypass_spec_v1=false invokes sanitize_speculative_path, which marks the compared register unknown and verifies the alternative branch. bpf_bypass_spec_v1 requires cpu_mitigations_off or token/initial CAP_PERFMON; ordinary userns root is insufficient.
rows.impact_limit: The reviewed example cannot establish an ordinary unprivileged unsafe-memory path through speculative verification. Low-32-bit-zero pointer alignment and mitigation behavior remain prerequisites; no new exploit is tested. Keep conditional/unresolved rather than equating enabled BPF with a complete verifier bypass.
rows.runtime_status: not collected; source gate is not deployed proof

rows.title: KEYS: encrypted: fix integer overflow of datablob_len
rows.source_gate: KEYS=y, ENCRYPTED_KEYS=m; encrypted_keys absent from default preload. key_type_lookup searches registered types and returns ENOKEY if missing; it does not automatically provide the key type. Host module loading/activation needed under autoload-disabled defaults. Once registered, own encrypted-key creation is not intrinsically host-root-only.
rows.impact_limit: Concrete integer truncation and large heap OOB write; no default tenant exposure claim while key type unregistered.
rows.runtime_status: not collected; source gate is not deployed proof

rows.title: keys: Pin request_key_auth payload in instantiate paths
rows.source_gate: KEYS=y; request_key/keyctl permitted, but instantiate/reject paths require an actual request_key_auth instantiation permit. Source invokes host /sbin/request-key via usermode helper. A binary/configuration inside a tenant alone does not establish an attacker-accessible host helper/auth context. No host helper setup found in inspected OS module/package references.
rows.impact_limit: Auth-payload UAF is serious; default tenant path unresolved until helper/auth-context prerequisites are established. Upstream fixed at inclusive .95 boundary.
rows.runtime_status: not collected; source gate is not deployed proof

rows.title: KEYS: fix overflow in keyctl_pkey_params_get_2()
rows.source_gate: KEYS, ASYMMETRIC_KEY_TYPE, ASYMMETRIC_PUBLIC_KEY_SUBTYPE, X509_CERTIFICATE_PARSER and CRYPTO_RSA=y. keyctl not denied by default seccomp. Own searchable asymmetric public key supports PKEY_ENCRYPT route without initial-userns capabilities; private-key PKCS8 parser is m but not needed for every affected operation.
rows.impact_limit: Heap output-buffer OOB write/read in keyctl asymmetric operation. Fixed in .95; include as boundary fix, not claim .95 affected.
rows.runtime_status: not collected; source gate is not deployed proof

rows.title: packet: use ubuf_info completion for TX_RING packets
rows.source_gate: AF_PACKET explicitly preloaded; namespace CAP_NET_RAW permits TX_RING. Socket payload/fragments can remain shared after early completion. Same baseline gate as other TX_RING defects; no extra host interface needed.
rows.impact_limit: Primary text proves early ring-slot reuse/payload ownership violation. Effect beyond attacker-owned packet data and a distinct kernel integrity/escape primitive remains for impact review; do not automatically equate it to arbitrary kernel write.
rows.runtime_status: not collected; source gate is not deployed proof

rows.title: KVM: x86: Cancel delayed I/O APIC EOI handling before destroying vCPUs
rows.source_gate: KVM feature defaults on, delegated /dev/kvm. KVM/Intel/AMD modules built; source hardware-config generator adds vendor module on vmx/svm. Tenant VMM can create irqchip/vCPUs, run guest and destroy VM. No nested VMX or special physical I/O device required. Actual virtualization support/module/device permissions are runtime facts.
rows.impact_limit: Delayed IOAPIC EOI work reaches freed vCPU; shared-kernel UAF. Default feature availability is distinct from proof that every compute/storage node runs a vulnerable KVM path.
rows.runtime_status: not collected; source gate is not deployed proof

rows.title: KVM: nVM: Ensure INVVPID is emulated on the correct physical CPU
rows.source_gate: Tenant-controlled KVM VMM; Intel VMX CPU/module with nested virtualization and VPID enabled. kvm_intel nested defaults true in reviewed source. Attacker can run L1/L2 and drive INVVPID/migration inside its VM; no initial-userns capability check substitutes for these hardware/runtime prerequisites.
rows.impact_limit: Stale translation after wrong-pCPU invalidation. Do not infer cross-VPS success solely from stale-TLB mechanism.
rows.runtime_status: not collected; source gate is not deployed proof

rows.title: KVM: nVMX: Service local TLB flushes on failed nested VM-Enter
rows.source_gate: Same Intel nested-VMX prerequisite; tenant VMM/guest can control failed/successful nested VM-entry and virtual VPID changes. Actual nested/VPID controls and CPU feature exposure unknown.
rows.impact_limit: Skipped TLB flush on failed VM-entry; stale guest translations. The scope of memory reached depends on the complete nested/KVM state, not CVSS alone.
rows.runtime_status: not collected; source gate is not deployed proof

rows.title: KVM: nVMX: Always flush vpid02 on first use
rows.source_gate: Same Intel nested-VMX/VPID support. L1 can perform VMXOFF/VMXON within its VM and reuse nested VPID; hardware CPU migration/VPID reuse remains runtime-dependent.
rows.impact_limit: Primary fix explicitly says stale TLB entries may come from a different vCPU or completely different VM; strongest stated cross-VM isolation consequence of this three-fix group. No vpsAdminOS reproduction performed.
rows.runtime_status: not collected; source gate is not deployed proof

rows.title: KVM: nVMX: Force MSR bitmap refresh if runtime eVMCS controls are modified
rows.source_gate: KVM_HYPERV=y. Tenant VMM enables KVM_CAP_HYPERV_ENLIGHTENED_VMCS through ordinary vCPU KVM_ENABLE_CAP; nested_enable_evmcs sets its flag without initial-userns capability. Requires Intel VMX/nested and eVMCS use; running the host under Hyper-V is not the same prerequisite as enabling guest eVMCS.
rows.impact_limit: Primary defect permits L2/L1-proxy access to L0 TPR due stale MSR bitmap. Explicit guest-to-host register boundary violation; full node-root/cross-VPS code execution is not demonstrated by that register access alone.
rows.runtime_status: not collected; source gate is not deployed proof

rows.title: perf: Reject exited events as group leaders
rows.source_gate: PERF_EVENTS=y; source perf_event_paranoid defaults 2. Per-task events excluding kernel profiling are allowed without CAP_PERFMON; default seccomp allows perf_event_open. Own event groups/exec/fd lifecycle suffice. Effective sysctl/LSM policy unknown.
rows.impact_limit: EXIT leader UAF. Package B records supported 6.12 affected interval .96–.107, fixed .108; do not mark .95 affected merely because perf is enabled.
rows.runtime_status: not collected; source gate is not deployed proof

rows.title: perf: Fix addr_filter_ranges lifetime
rows.source_gate: CPU_SUP_INTEL=y builds Intel PT pmu (arch/x86/events/intel/Makefile pt.o); pt_init checks actual X86_FEATURE_INTEL_PT. Own per-task exclude_kernel events/filter/inherit/fork allowed at upstream paranoid2, without host CAP_PERFMON; no dedicated CONFIG_INTEL_PT symbol should be invented. Actual PT PMU and policy unknown.
rows.impact_limit: addr_filter_ranges freed while RCU paths read/write ranges. Hardware capability qualification; ordinary software perf events alone do not reach address-filter implementation.
rows.runtime_status: not collected; source gate is not deployed proof

rows.title: inet: frags: publish queues before arming timer
rows.source_gate: IPv4/IPv6 fragment core built; namespace fragment timeout sysctls registered per netns and writable by namespace CAP_NET_ADMIN. ipfrag_time parser has no positive minimum, so tenant can select zero then drive local fragment input. Default timeouts positive.
rows.impact_limit: Timer before hash publication leaves stale fragment queue; not host-only despite nondefault timeout.
rows.runtime_status: not collected; source gate is not deployed proof

rows.title: udp: fix potential use-after-free in tunnel segmentation
rows.source_gate: UDP tunnel segmentation core available; preloaded vxlan/udp_tunnel, delegated TUN and AF_PACKET permit tenant-admin-controlled encapsulated/nonlinear traffic and own tunnel configuration. Needs pull-induced skb head relocation, not arbitrary UDP traffic.
rows.impact_limit: Stale UDP header after pull reallocates skb head; concrete potential UAF. No platform-specific weaponization verified.
rows.runtime_status: not collected; source gate is not deployed proof

rows.title: net: gro: properly validate BIG TCP aggregation criteria
rows.source_gate: Software GRO/TCP/IPv4/IPv6 built. Device gro_max_size defaults GRO_LEGACY_MAX_SIZE; tenant namespace CAP_NET_ADMIN can raise GRO_MAX_SIZE for own device through rtnetlink and arrange suitable veth/TUN/AF_PACKET traffic. Needs >64KiB aggregation plus insufficient pre-MAC room/nonplain protocol condition.
rows.impact_limit: Pre-head memmove OOB write is concrete; BIG TCP is opt-in tenant network configuration, not universal default receive behavior.
rows.runtime_status: not collected; source gate is not deployed proof

rows.title: sctp: drop a chunk if its transport was removed
rows.source_gate: SCTP preloaded. Removed-transport path needs an association, authenticated ASCONF DEL-IP/ADDIP and concurrent socket-backlog/direct receive handling. Per-netns addip/auth controls are tenant-admin writable; defaults off.
rows.impact_limit: Transport restored into last_data_from after removal, later SACK UAF. No unconfigured Internet exposure claim.
rows.runtime_status: not collected; source gate is not deployed proof

rows.title: sctp: stop processing a packet once its association is deleted
rows.source_gate: SCTP preloaded; requires matching endpoint/association handshake and bundled chunks on socket backlog. Distinct from ADDIP-only bugs: this described COOKIE ECHO/SHUTDOWN/ACK path does not establish an ADDIP/auth toggle requirement. Tenant can create own listener/peers using ordinary sockets.
rows.impact_limit: Freed transport last_time_heard write and association UAF after same-packet deletion. Shared-kernel memory corruption, not demonstrated platform host root.
rows.runtime_status: not collected; source gate is not deployed proof

rows.title: sctp: hold asoc or transport before mod_timer() in timer handlers
rows.source_gate: SCTP preloaded; association/transport timer firing/rearm versus cleanup, plus proto-unreachable variant. Generic SCTP socket lifecycle, no ADDIP requirement established by primary description. Own sockets/peer traffic/close can exercise lifecycle.
rows.impact_limit: Rearming timer before acquiring reference permits freed-object refcount operations. No platform-specific exploit verified.
rows.runtime_status: not collected; source gate is not deployed proof

rows.title: xfrm: Fix dev use-after-free in xfrm async resumption
rows.source_gate: XFRM_USER/INTERFACE=y and ESP/IPv4/IPv6 XFRM built; namespace CAP_NET_ADMIN configures states/interfaces. VTI drivers are m/unpreloaded, but built-in xfrmi_rcv_cb also assigns skb->dev, so source is not exclusive to operator-loaded VTI. Needs asynchronous resumption plus device replacement/teardown.
rows.impact_limit: Device-reference imbalance and UAF; tenant-configured XFRM interface path plausible. Actual crypto async path/state/traffic remain candidate-specific prerequisites.
rows.runtime_status: not collected; source gate is not deployed proof

rows.title: xfrm: save input state data before secpath resets
rows.source_gate: XFRM_USER/INTERFACE=y, namespace CAP_NET_ADMIN control. VTI needs modules, but built-in XFRM interface cross-netns callback or XFRM_MAX_DEPTH error can reset secpath without VTI. Tenant can control own nested network namespaces/state deletion.
rows.impact_limit: State protocol/type dereference after final secpath reference reset is a concrete UAF. Configuring depth/receive/callback sequence is required; generic arbitrary inbound packet is insufficient.
rows.runtime_status: not collected; source gate is not deployed proof

rows.title: esp: downgrade zerocopy managed frags before mutating skb frags
rows.source_gate: INET_ESP/INET6_ESP=y, XFRM configuration namespace-scoped; needed AES/GCM paths built. Requires managed zerocopy frags on an out-of-place ESP output path. io_uring and relevant user operations pass default seccomp, but effective io_uring and crypto selection must be checked before deployment conclusions.
rows.impact_limit: Mismatched managed-page ownership causes UAF/refcount loss and page leak; do not attribute every ESP output to this particular path.
rows.runtime_status: not collected; source gate is not deployed proof

rows.title: xfrm: add missing rcu_read_lock(), skb_dst_force() and dev_hold() for xfrm_trans_reinject()
rows.source_gate: XFRM transport-mode reinjection path built and PREEMPT_RCU=y in exact historical config. Requires workqueue-deferred receive packet with unpinned destination/device and concurrent namespace/device/route lifetime change; namespace CAP_NET_ADMIN can control its network lifecycle.
rows.impact_limit: Missing RCU/dst/device references; warning evidence and lifetime risk, not proof of controlled host code execution. Introduction/range is owned by B stable join.
rows.runtime_status: not collected; source gate is not deployed proof

rows.title: xfrm: fix compat ALLOCSPI request use-after-free
rows.source_gate: XFRM_USER_COMPAT=y and IA32_EMULATION/COMPAT=y; compat ALLOCSPI and receiver path available to a 32-bit process under default seccomp. XFRM netlink control requires namespace CAP_NET_ADMIN, not initial-userns privilege. No xfrm_compat module load gate in this exact build.
rows.impact_limit: Compat translation attaches/frees shared skb child, races receiver copy (UAF plus four-byte overread). Requires compat messages and multicast/receiver arrangement.
rows.runtime_status: not collected; source gate is not deployed proof
